series_measurements.quality: All 18 long rows returned exact prompt IDs, cached_tokens=0, 128 completion tokens, and the requested retrieval fact. Target-only q1 comparison matched all three 1K outputs but mismatched all 15 outputs from 4K through 32,640 after 67–107 common tokens; the 1K aggregate excludes the first-live capture/JIT row. This is screened evidence, not an exact or promotion-grade context curve.
